newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 23.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices -April 23.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers edged up on Wednesday after healthy enquiries emerged over less competitive prices in South Korea, traders said. Japan's upcoming golden week holiday also helped boost buying interest, they said. The 180-cst grade in Singapore was quoted about $1-$2 per tonne lower than prices in South Korea. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
